name: Mattresses and box springs

comps.spec: Hundreds of steel coil springs (open or pocketed), about 1.4–2.5 mm wire
Heavy steel border rod, about 4–5 mm, around the spring unit
comps.loc: Top and bottom edges of the spring unit

comps.spec: Polyurethane and memory foam layers, 5–25 cm — padding, cushions and insulation
comps.loc: Top layers; the whole core in foam mattresses

comps.spec: Quilted ticking and polypropylene dust cover
Pine frame and slats in the box spring
Wire grid and torsion springs in the box spring
comps.loc: Box spring, on the wooden frame

notes: Many cheap foam mattresses have a glass-fibre fire barrier inside the cover: don't cut or wash that inner cover, and don't sleep on a torn one. Damp mattresses grow mould; leave them.
